## MCP - Tenant - Resolve

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/tenant-resolve

**Description:** Resolves Discord guild_id to tenant_id via API backend.

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["action", "user_id", "guild_id", "backend_api_url", "backend_service_token"],
  "properties": {
    "action": { "type": "string", "enum": ["resolve"] },
    "user_id": { "type": "string" },
    "guild_id": { "type": "string" },
    "backend_api_url": { "type": "string" },
    "backend_service_token": { "type": "string" }
  }
}
```

**Returns:** Raw API response - plugin handles verification

**RFC:** RFC-049 Entity Storage Architecture
